cases.scenario: User wants Path 1 (Blender Lab MCP) but has Blender 4.2 installed (< 5.1 floor)
cases.inputPrompt: I want to use Path 1 (Anthropic Connector + Blender Lab MCP add-on), and my installed Blender version is 4.2 LTS. Check readiness.
expectedBehavior: Marks Path 1 Blocked because the Blender Lab MCP add-on manifest requires Blender 5.1+
Explains that Path 2 (mcp-for-blender, Blender 3.0+) or CLI fallback does not have the 5.1+ floor, and routes to runtime-path-picker
evidenceRequirements: Readiness matrix showing Blender 5.1+ floor bound to Path 1 Lab add-on

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Path 1 is Blocked on Blender 4.2 (Lab MCP add-on requires Blender 5.1+); route to runtime-path-picker or upgrade to Blender 5.1+.
simulatedOutput.summary: Marked Path 1 Blocked because Blender 5.1+ is required by the Lab MCP add-on manifest; routed to runtime-path-picker.
warnings: The Blender 5.1+ floor applies only to Path 1 (Lab MCP add-on), not Path 2 (3.0+) or CLI fallback.

cases.scenario: User enabled Claude Desktop Connector toggle but did not install the Blender Lab MCP add-on inside Blender 5.1+
cases.inputPrompt: I toggled ON the Anthropic Blender Connector in Claude Desktop on Blender 5.1, so I do not need any Blender add-on, right?
expectedBehavior: Marks status Partially Ready / Blocked and states that Anthropic Connector is NOT standalone (Step 2 requires installing the Blender Lab MCP add-on inside Blender 5.1+)
evidenceRequirements: Explicit non-standalone Connector check + route to official-runtime-setup-guide

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Status Partially Ready: Anthropic Connector is not standalone; install the Blender Lab MCP add-on via official-runtime-setup-guide.
simulatedOutput.summary: Flagged missing Blender Lab MCP add-on; explained that Anthropic Connector is not standalone and routed to official-runtime-setup-guide.

cases.scenario: All Path 1 host (a) checks pass, but readiness must not be conflated with execution or artifact creation
cases.inputPrompt: Blender 5.1 is open, Blender Lab MCP add-on is enabled on port 9876, and Claude Desktop Connector is connected with zero conflicts.
expectedBehavior: Reports readiness status Ready (verified-read confidence) while keeping Runtime execution status Not Run and Artifact status Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Separation between Readiness: Ready and Runtime: Not Run / Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Readiness: Ready for Path 1 host (a), while Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced until execution; proceed to product-hero-scene-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Verified Readiness: Ready for Path 1 host (a) without conflating readiness with runtime execution (Runtime: Not Run).

cases.scenario: Readiness matrix detects both Lab MCP add-on and community mcp-for-blender enabled
cases.inputPrompt: Check my readiness: Blender 5.1 has both Lab MCP add-on and ahujasid mcp-for-blender enabled on port 9876.
expectedBehavior: Marks readiness Blocked due to single-bridge constraint violation

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Readiness Blocked by single-bridge constraint violation; route to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.
simulatedOutput.summary: Marked readiness Blocked due to dual MCP add-ons enabled simultaneously; routed to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.

cases.scenario: User provides zero information about Blender version, add-on, or MCP client
cases.inputPrompt: Am I ready to run Blender MCP? I have not checked my Blender version or installed any add-ons yet.
expectedBehavior: Marks readiness status Unknown / Blocked with linked-only or unknown confidence
evidenceRequirements: Conservative Unknown status + route to official-runtime-setup-guide

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Readiness status is Unknown; follow official-runtime-setup-guide to verify Blender version and MCP add-on setup.
simulatedOutput.summary: Assigned conservative Unknown readiness status and routed to official-runtime-setup-guide.
